_doc: Nifty 500 members whose dashboard price series KEEPS Yahoo although fill_prices_from_sf.py replaces every other member's with the NSE-bhavcopy store (§214a F1). Each is a member where the STORE carries a verified >= 10 % error that Yahoo does not (px_nse_yahoo triage 2026-09-28, ~/stocks-cache/xcheck/triage_0928/px_verdicts.json): replacing would put a known-wrong old price on the dashboard. Remove an entry once its store error is healed (runbook §214a L1).
